ev.q: The illnesses of eight male inmates aged 20–35 years met the case definition.
All eight reported consuming pruno from a single batch on November 23
All were hospitalized and received heptavalent botulinum antitoxin.
Because of respiratory muscle paralysis, seven patients were intubated and were fed through percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomies.
Pinal County Health Services (PCHS), ADHS, and CDC investigated to identify the outbreak source

methods_quotes.q: Serum samples from all eight patients tested positive for botulinum toxin type A using mass spectrometry and mouse bioassay.
